# Hoygi

> Hoygi sells a bio-collagen gel face mask. The product is a single sheet of
> bio-collagen gel worn for approximately 40 minutes.

## Product

- **Name:** Hoygi Bio-Collagen Gel Face Mask
- **Category:** Korean skincare / hydrating gel sheet mask
- **Pack size:** 4 masks
- **Price:** $39.00 USD
- **Sheet dimensions:** 196 × 138 × 19 mm
- **Wear time:** approximately 40 minutes

## Formulation

- **Low-molecular-weight hyaluronic acid** — a smaller-molecule hyaluronic acid,
  formulated to absorb rather than remain on the surface.
- **Yeast Fermentation Filtrate** — included to support the skin barrier and help
  stabilise the skin's micro-ecosystem.

The mask is designed to hydrate and to leave skin looking smoother, fresher and more
radiant. It is a cosmetic product. It is not a drug, makes no medical claims, and is
not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition.
